title: docs(objectui/actions): `preflight` is still described as "Planned: the console does not send the read yet", but #31808 made it live
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAmAzSRKZHAn7T8sArV

Filing gate: ① a follow-up owed by landed work (#31808). A published docs page tells authors a live key does nothing. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: an author who reads `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` before declaring an action's `preflight` is told the console ignores it. They then hand-roll a companion read instead. The skills card #31860 (in flight) teaches the key as live, so the docs and the skill would disagree.
Reader who acts: the lane that owns `content/docs/protocol/objectui/**` (triage routes it). It is a two-line prose fix.
Dedupe (open and closed): `preflight Planned actions.mdx`. 0 hits. #31840 (spec) and #31808 (reader) are closed and did not edit these lines.

## Readings (`origin/main` `ff04ad811`)

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` L235: `preflight?: Preflight; // … (planned: not drawn yet)`.
- Same file L568: `> **Planned.** The key parses and is judged at parse today, but the console's param dialog does not send the read, draw the panel or fill a param yet.`
- `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` row `preflight` (about L283): `"status": "live", "verifiedAt": "2026-11-09"`. The note names the console readers: `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `actionDialogCompanion.ts`, `ActionParamDialog.tsx`, and `ActionRunner.preflightReadFiller`.

Found by the #31860 card thread's sweep. It is outside that card's surface (`skills/objectstack-ui/**`).

## Done when

Both lines describe `preflight` as live, matching the ledger row, and no other sentence on the page calls it planned.

Clause-②: no · changeset: none expected (docs prose)
Suggested grade: p3
